subject: HealPharm DPA redline + UK addendum — pseudonymization and export safeguards
messages:
From: Dr. Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@healpharm.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: DPA + UK Addendum questions for research pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team ran the DPA + UK Addendum through initial review and surfaced two items where we need clarity before we can sign: 1) a tighter definition for 'pseudonymized research data' (we need to confirm what technical steps Redwood will take), and 2) a request to add escrow-style logging to the UK Addendum for auditability of cross-border calls during the pilot.

I'm attaching the redline they've proposed and a short spec from our privacy lead on pseudonymization. Can your legal/compliance folks confirm whether Redwood can accept the proposed clause that limits export to only transient processing nodes and requires an auditable log that we can review quarterly?

Proposed next steps from our side: 1) quick alignment call with legal/compliance, 2) confirm whether logs can be shared under NDA, 3) sign DPA once we have a short addendum to the UK IDTA.

Best,
Anika

Attachments: HealPharm_DPA_v1.2_redline.pdf (pdf stub), pseudonymization-spec.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@healpharm.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T13:34:00Z
Subject: Fwd: DPA + UK Addendum questions for research pilot

Laura / Kim / Marcus — forwarding HealPharm's redline and pseudonymization spec. They want two confirmations: (A) Redwood's technical approach to 'pseudonymized research data' (what we strip/retain; degree of reversibility) and (B) whether we can provide auditable cross-border call logs quarterly under NDA.

Short asks:
- Laura: can legal accept a narrow escrow/logging clause limited to quarterly reviews and redacted identifiers?
- Kim: from compliance, is the requested audit log (call-level + timestamp + node region) something we can produce without breaking other customers' telemetry?
- Marcus: infrastructure feasibility — can we produce a per-customer cross-border call log that excludes raw payloads and ties only to request ids?

I proposed a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT — ok for you all?

Thanks — Stephanie
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
(see attached)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@healpharm.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@healpharm.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T08:02:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA + UK Addendum questions for research pilot

Stephanie / team / Anika — thanks for the flag. Quick notes after a first pass:

1) Pseudonymization definition: we can accept a definition that describes irreversible tokenization or hashing where the key/material to re-identify is not retained by Redwood. We will not accept language that leaves room for reversible pseudonymization unless HealPharm explicitly requests re-identification and signs a data subject access and re-identification procedure.

2) Escrow-style logging: we are open to producing an auditable log that contains timestamps, request IDs, region of processing, and a limited set of metadata, provided: (a) logs never include raw input/outputs or PII, (b) production of logs is subject to a narrow NDA and written attestation on use, and (c) we can schedule quarterly read-only access via a secure share (we cannot provide direct DB access).

3) UK Addendum/IDTA sequencing: legal prefers to sign the main DPA with an explicit annex that references the UK Addendum once the pseudonymization/legal language is finalized. We recommend capturing the audit/logging process in that annex.

Next step: I'll draft suggested language for the addendum and a short exhibit describing the log fields. Stephanie — please confirm whether HealPharm needs the logs to include the call latency or just timestamp + request id + region.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection
Redwood Inference

-----Inline below: sample clause language (drafted)
[Draft clause begins]
Redwood will provide quarterly auditable logs to Customer under NDA. Logs will include: (i) UTC timestamp; (ii) anonymized request identifier; (iii) processing region; (iv) model variant used. Logs will not contain raw inputs or outputs, nor will they include direct identifiers.
[Draft clause ends]

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@healpharm.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA + UK Addendum questions for research pilot

Team / Anika — compliance check in. Marcus and I ran the feasibility test in our staging cluster: we can emit a per-customer JSON log entry that contains the fields Laura listed. Constraints and notes:

- We will NOT include any raw payloads or reconstruction keys in the logs.
- Request identifiers will be hashed with a customer-specific salt to avoid correlation across customers.
- Retention: logs are retained for 90 days by default; we can offer extended retention (up to 12 months) for paid pilots subject to procurement approval and storage cost pass-through.
- Access: secure, read-only export via S3 pre-signed URL or a secure Drive share. Quarterly exports will be generated within 10 business days of quarter close.

Marcus: the only technical hurdle is ensuring the hash salt rotation is coordinated with requests to avoid breaking HealPharm's ability to match request IDs on their side. We should include a short appendix on matching procedure.

Anika — does HealPharm require more granular metadata (e.g., model logits or embeddings)? If so, that will require a separate security review and likely won't be permissible for a pilot.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: UK_Addendum_draft.docx (docx stub)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Anika Sharma <anika.sharma@healpharm.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA + UK Addendum questions for research pilot — proposed path forward

Anika — thanks for your patience while we pulled legal and compliance in. Summary and ask:

1) Redwood can accept HealPharm's proposed pseudonymization approach if the term is defined to require non-reversible tokenization (we'll gate re-identification on a documented process).
2) We can deliver quarterly auditable logs limited to timestamp, hashed request id, processing region, and model variant. Logs will be provided as read-only exports under NDA and retained for 90 days by default. Extended retention available as an add-on.

Can you confirm by EOD Friday whether HealPharm: (A) is OK with hashed request IDs + matching appendix, and (B) needs extended retention so we can include procurement language for storage fees? Upon confirmation Laura will circulate redline language for the UK Addendum and a short exhibit describing the log fields.

Next steps once we have confirmation: Laura to send addendum redline -> HealPharm to sign -> finalize pilot kickoff date.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
HealPharm reply expected: "Confirmed — hashed IDs OK; request 12-month retention for pilot." or "We need matching appendix and cannot accept hashed IDs unless we can provide the salt."
